remarks: Welcome to this spacious 3 BEDROOM TOWNHOUSE offering a functional layout, plenty of natural light & room to make it your own! With approx. 1,079 SQ FT ABOVE GRADE, the main floor features a generous living room with FIREPLACE, dining area & a spacious kitchen with plenty of room for everyday living. Upstairs you'll find 3 BEDROOMS & a 4PC BATH, including a large primary with excellent closet space. The FULL UNFINISHED BASEMENT provides laundry, utility space & loads of storage, with plenty of potential for future development. The condo lifestyle makes this a great option for first-time buyers, families or those looking for a more LOW-MAINTENANCE property. Conveniently located in an established northeast Edmonton community near SCHOOLS, PARKS, SHOPPING, TRANSIT & EVERYDAY AMENITIES, with easy access to major commuter routes. An excellent opportunity to own an AFFORDABLE 3-BEDROOM HOME with space to grow! (id:67522)
